system.description:
You may immediately use two [Timing: Setup] Kannagi or Healer Archetype skills.

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill that activates two magics at once by performing different chants at the same time, replacing the magic chant by dancing kagura, which is a collection of actions with various meanings and prayers.
